comparison_semantics.population_rule: T1/T2 decided directions always equal the H4/D01 direction, so policy populations are strict comparable sub-populations of D01 with identical frozen downstream semantics
comparison_semantics.uplift_rule: uplift only within one capability basis; entry-conditioned vs opportunity uplift is always null with reason INCOMPARABLE_CAPABILITY_SEMANTICS

ma_ablation.rule: T2 vs T2+MA agreement only; 50/200 not tuned

motivating_evidence: V0.3 DEV exploration D08 (+7.55pp pooled) is MOTIVATING_EVIDENCE only, not a promoted strategy rule; T1/T2 are clean preregistered policies tested prospectively

policies.D01: frozen V0.3 baseline: H4 structural direction only (BULL on confirmed HH/HL, BEAR on confirmed LH/LL, else NEUTRAL)
policies.T1: strict alignment: BUY iff H4=BULL AND H1 internal flow=BULL AND location=DISCOUNT; SELL iff H4=BEAR AND H1 internal flow=BEAR AND location=PREMIUM; else NEUTRAL
policies.T2: phase-aware: BUY iff phase=BULL_CONTINUATION; SELL iff phase=BEAR_CONTINUATION; pullback phases remain explicit states (measured for causal H1 realignment), never auto-traded; else NEUTRAL
policies.T2_MA: ablation only (NOT part of T1/T2): T2 direction kept only when H1 MA50/200 direction agrees; MA parameters not tuned

pullback_realignment.note: diagnostic horizon only; no maximum-wait trading rule is defined
